variants.headline: Colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
The colony is openly defying its charter. The defiance is established; a particular punishment or response is not. An assessment of {target} should distinguish the political and legal question posed by that stance from an invented account of what the home world has done in reply.

Working people deserve a voice in arguments about the authority under which they live. They also deserve to be kept in view when political gestures are admired. Labour should ask whose interests a position serves without inventing either the cost of defiance or a promised improvement in daily life.

We judge {target} adversely. Defiance demands a serious account of responsibility, and a bold stance should not be allowed to shelter inadequate political judgment behind the attraction of its own gesture. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.

variants.headline: A public break with charter authority
variants.sub: The colony has taken an openly defiant position towards its charter.
variants.body:
The relationship between local action and charter authority is an open question of defiance in {colony}. That is the development reported here. variants.sub: The colony is openly defying its charter.
variants.body:
